snippet.title: FightBit v1.8 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/972500/FightBit/

FightBit is a side-scrolling beat-em-up with pseudo 8-bit graphics and rudimentary gameplay influenced by contemporary melee focused combat games. Defeat the Dragon Queen and her army!

Features:

- Fight various enemies with various attack patterns
- Pseudo 8-bit graphics
- Electronic rock soundtrack
